system_prompt_style.note: Prompts assembled from agent_prompt.md plus configurable glossary/data-warehouse introduction from bi.yaml.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: supports flexible catalog storage backends with vector-based or BM25-based retrieval
env_context_strategy.note: Catalog retrieval (vector or BM25) plus agent tools like show_schema; BM25 is the fallback when no embedding model is configured.

context_compaction.note: context_manager.py handles context window and token management; summary prompt indicates conversation summarization.

observation_format.note: Tool results are text/SQL results; plotly charts are rendered in the UI, not clearly returned to the model as images.

tool_count.evidence_quote:
text2sql
data_analysis
run_python_code
search_knowledge
show_schema
save_report
memory_tools
mcp_tools
tool_count.note: Counting text2sql, data_analysis, run_python_code, search_knowledge, show_schema, save_report, AskHuman; memory_tools require an embedding model and mcp_tools are configuration-injected (not counted).

edit_primitive.note: No file-editing tool in the tool list; only save_report writes output.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: MCP Support: Integration with MCP tools by configuration
tool_schema_source.note: LangChain @tool decorators derive schemas from signatures; MCP tools add fetched schemas.

loop_primitives.note: Main agent loop is ReAct (llm_node/use_tool); text2sql is a fixed LangGraph pipeline with execute/score/regenerate repair.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: LangGraph Workflows: Core orchestration using state machines for complex multi-step processes
planning_granularity.note: No plan object stored; workflow structure is fixed in the graph.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: A specialized sub-agent (built on [deepagents](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents)) that the main agent delegates complex analysis to.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Data Analysis Agent: Specialized sub-agent that orchestrates forecasting, anomaly detection, root-cause drill-down and Python analysis

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Low-confidence SQL pauses the graph and asks the user to approve / reject / edit before the answer is returned.
human_in_loop.note: Confidence gate default false (enable_confidence_gate: true # default false); AskHuman tool also asks users for more context.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: approved, high-confidence (question → SQL) pairs are auto-captured into the runtime example store and blended into few-shot retrieval
long_term_memory.note: Pattern memory and golden SQL are off by default; catalog retrieval uses vector store when an embedding model is configured.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Persistent Memory: Conversation management and user characteristic memory based on LangGraph checkpointing
state_persistence.note: SQLite-based conversation checkpointing with thread_id resumption.

self_verification.evidence_quote: an LLM evaluator scores the SQL against the source-table schema using a 6-check rubric
self_verification.note: SQL execution result feeds back into retry routing (closest to test_execution); confidence gate/judge off by default.

rollback.note: No undo/revert mechanism described; the agent queries data rather than editing a repo.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: text2sql_llm: (Optional) Specialized model for SQL generation. If not configured, uses `default_llm`
cost_controls.note: Per-task model selection (text2sql_llm, analysis_llm); max_tokens configured per provider; metrics give token/cost accounting.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Execution errors are classified (syntax, timeout, security, missing table, ...)
timeouts.note: SQL query timeouts are classified; no run-level timeout described.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote:
**`local`** (Default)
- **Performance**: Fastest execution
- **Security**: Least secure (code runs in current Python process)
execution_isolation.note: restricted_local and docker executors selectable via python_executor config.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: **Capabilities**: Full Python capabilities and library access
filesystem_access.note: Relative to the host process under the default local executor.

network_policy.note: Network isolation only applies to the non-default docker executor; default local executor has open network.

permission_model.note: Only gate is the off-by-default confidence gate; otherwise tool calls execute directly.

tracing.note: Off by default; audit log and metrics also available.

replayability.evidence_quote: **Deterministic replay**: `evals/runledger/` replays recorded LLM cassettes in CI
replayability.note: Replay of recorded cassettes; environment access not required in replay mode.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: LLM-as-Judge: collect generated SQL over gold cases, then judge it with the shared rubric evaluator

guardrails.evidence_quote: sink `log` or `file`, SQL literals masked by default
guardrails.note: SQL literal masking in audit logs; RestrictedPython/docker executors and SQL result limit constrain actions.

target_domain.note: Domain is business intelligence / data analytics (other); MCP integration adds general tool use.
